headline: Gracewing Healer
title: Aniimo Gracewing Guide | Flutternym Evolves at Level 21 | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Gracewing is the healer you want in Aniimo. Catch a Flutternym and raise it to level twenty one to evolve it. Gracewing is a Wind Aniimo with a team heal skill called Wind of Rejuvenation. Its trait Flutter Heal boosts healing when it fights, and it keeps helping from off the field. Pair it with a strong damage dealer. Who is your favorite healer? Comment below!
description: Gracewing is a Wind healer in Aniimo that evolves from Flutternym at level 21 and heals the whole team.
